dokodela.title: Dokodela
dokodela.desc: Integrated hospital management system: patients, insurers, stock, billing and scheduling in one place.
dokodela.intro: Dokodela is our Integrated Clinic Management System: a platform built to digitize and automate the administrative, clinical and financial processes of clinics, hospitals and medical centers. It covers the entire patient journey — from registration and scheduling, through clinical care and diagnosis, to billing, insurer collections and financial reporting — removing manual work and reducing errors at every step.
dokodela.objective: Modernize clinic and hospital management, from patient care to closing accounts with insurers.
features: Daily Billing and Collection Map Issuance

sgePro.title: SGE-PRO
sgePro.desc: Complete academic and financial management for schools, institutes and universities.
sgePro.intro: SGE-PRO is our Student Management System: a platform built to digitize and centralize the academic, administrative and financial management of educational institutions, from student enrollment to the issuing of report cards, documents and reports. It covers the whole school cycle — enrollment, classes and subjects, grading, attendance and tuition control — with a single dashboard for school leadership to track academic and financial indicators in real time.
sgePro.objective: Streamline an entire institution's academic and financial management in a single system.
features: Real-Time Tuition and Fee Payment Control
